intro: Nicaragua is governed by Daniel Ortega and Rosario Murillo, who hold near-total power.

chapters.title: How it works
text: A 2025 constitutional change made them co-presidents and gave the presidency control over other branches. Opposition parties, independent media and many churches and charities have been shut down.

chapters.title: Exile
text: Hundreds of critics have been stripped of citizenship and expelled.

keyTerms.meaning: One of two people sharing the presidency.
